end.summary:
Asha practised naming cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and objects.
Aditya answered 3 of 5 naming attempts without help.
They identified flat and curved faces correctly in 2 of 2 attempts.
They explained that a cone has one flat face and a cylinder has two flat faces.
Teach-back was not passed; turning a solid was still linked to changing its name.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming solids and describing their flat and curved faces. Aditya used features such as a pointed tip, flat ends and the number of flat faces to identify cones and cylinders. They also noticed that unequal-sized faces do not make an object a cube. The mix-up about a solid changing its name when turned was not corrected by the end; at home, rotate a ball, cone or box and ask, “Is it still the same solid?”
